hero.title: A custom CRM for one of Raebareli's largest Mahindra dealerships
hero.subtitle: Om Group needed a unified system to manage leads, inquiries, test drives, and customer follow-ups across their Mahindra automobile dealership operations.

introduction.text: Om Group operates a Mahindra automobile dealership in Raebareli, handling vehicle sales, service bookings, and customer relationships across a growing operation. They approached Trai Inc to replace their fragmented lead management — scattered across notebooks, WhatsApp, and memory — with a single digital system purpose-built for dealership workflows.

challenge.text: Operating multiple automotive dealerships and educational campuses across Uttar Pradesh using manual spreadsheets led to lead leakage, delayed invoicing cycles, and zero cross-branch visibility for leadership.

solution.text: We architected a unified, multi-tenant enterprise ERP and CRM with role-based access control (RBAC), automated multi-channel lead distribution, real-time GST invoicing, and two-way WhatsApp business messaging.

results.text: Achieved 100% digital adoption across all 8 regional branches within 45 days, reduced manual administrative hours by 68%, and accelerated lead-to-conversion response time by 3.8x.
